vrun_cancelling: Interrupting: ending the processes of the stage...
vrun_cancel_hint: Interrupt ends the processes of the stage in progress. No approval is issued.
vrun_why_dependency: Blocked: depends on a stage that did not finish well.
vrun_why_preflight: Blocked: a prerequisite was not available.
vrun_why_fail-fast: Did not run: the run stopped at the first failure.
vrun_why_cancelled: Did not run: the run was interrupted.
vrun_events_empty: Waiting for the first events of the run.
vrun_logs_note: Many tools write progress and warnings to the error output; that is normal. Whether the step failed is told by its state in the table, not by the log text.
vrun_logs_failed: This step failed. The log below helps to understand why.
vrun_logs_command_hint: Recorded by JGates, not by the tool.
vrun_crashed: The run process died before writing the final result. Below, the partial report.
vrun_reload_note: Events continue from where they stopped; reloading the page does not repeat lines.
vrun_connection_lost: The JGates server is not answering. The screen tries again every 3 seconds; the validation may still be running meanwhile. If you closed jgates ui, open it again to keep following.
vrun_stalled: No new output for {time}, but the process is still alive. Some scanners download large databases (for example grype's vulnerability database) and write nothing for a while. You can wait or cancel.
